description: Whether a message raises an alert: DISTRESS severity always, URGENCY when alert_on_urgency is set; never for a format_unconfirmed call (sec 4.2), a VTS call (format or category 103), or a call without an EOS (cut at the receiver's character limit, F-27). Summary/body texts are informative.

compare.method: expected.alert is normative and exact; summary/body are informative.
